accesRefuse: This page is reserved for company administrators.

infosLegales.sousTitre: Displayed on every document generated (invoices, receipts, delivery notes, proforma).
infosLegales.aideFne: These details appear on your standardised e-invoices (FNE), as on the DGI template.

caisses.sousTitre: Where sales reps hand over their deposits (cash and other collected payment methods).

remises.sousTitre: Beyond this threshold, a sales rep can no longer approve the discount alone — only a manager or admin can apply it.
remises.erreurSeuil: The threshold must be a percentage between 0 and 100.

stock.exigerJustificatif: Require a supporting document (photo/PDF) for any manual stock adjustment

devise.sousTitre: Applies to every amount shown in the app (sales, stock, receivables, receipts…).

organigramme.sousTitre: Affiliate each sales rep with a team run by a team leader (manager) — the target set for the team leader will then be calculated as the sum of sales from all the sales reps on their team.
organigramme.affecterCommercial: Assign a sales rep to a team

facturation.sousTitre: Check with your accountant before relying on these calculations for real invoices.
facturation.assujettiLabel: My company charges VAT (standard or simplified regime)
facturation.assujettiAide: Once enabled, each product must be configured individually (VAT applicable or not, and at what rate) from the Stock page — the rate often varies by type of goods.

rapportsVisite.sousTitre: When a sales rep confirms a visit during a route, they can record the stock situation at the client (shelf and back-stock) with up to 3 supporting photos.
rapportsVisite.photoObligatoire: Photo required to submit the report
rapportsVisite.activeTexte: Enabled: at least one photo must be added.
rapportsVisite.desactiveTexte: Disabled: the report can be sent without a photo.

champsPersonnalises.sousTitre: Add your own questions for your market research — they'll appear automatically in sales reps' visit report form.
champsPersonnalises.libellePlaceholder: E.g.: Is the display present in the window?
champsPersonnalises.erreurOptions: Enter at least one option, comma-separated.

concurrents.sousTitre: Record the competitor products to monitor — sales reps will be able to check their presence on the shelf at each client visited, to calculate your shelf presence rate.

journalCaisse.sousTitre: Define who must approve a cash outflow, and above what amount.
journalCaisse.toujoursValider: Always require approval, regardless of amount
journalCaisse.seuilAide: Below this amount, the request is automatically accepted when created (no human approver).
journalCaisse.rolesValidateurs: Who can approve a cash outflow

fondConnexion.sousTitre: Replaces the background illustration shown on the login screen — shared across all companies for now (no per-company login page yet).
fondConnexion.confirmation: Image updated. Reload the login page to see it.

rappelsInventaire.sousTitre: Sets how often a reminder appears on the Dashboard to carry out a stock and/or cash inventory.

transferts.sousTitre: Determines whether confirming receipt of a transfer (between two cash registers, or between a cash register and a bank) requires a supporting document (photo of the deposit/withdrawal slip).
transferts.exigerJustificatif: Require a supporting document to confirm a transfer

tracabilite.sousTitre: Enables tracking product lot numbers (expiry, FIFO, delivery traceability in case of a production issue). Always works even when disabled — this setting only makes the lot number mandatory on every stock entry rather than optional.
tracabilite.rendreObligatoire: Make the lot number mandatory on every stock entry

regularisation.sousTitre: Determines who can regularize a discrepancy found during a cash inventory (generates the correcting entry in the cash journal).

comptabilite.sousTitre: For each type of operation, choose the account that receives the counterpart in exported entries. If an account is missing, create it with '➕ Create an account or sub-account'.
comptabilite.aucunPlanComptable: No chart of accounts yet. Load the starter SYSCOHADA chart (editable), or create accounts one by one below.
comptabilite.aideCharges: Account debited when the till pays an expense without a specific account.
comptabilite.aideClients: Account credited when a customer pays.
comptabilite.aideEcarts: Account used to regularise a till shortage or surplus.
comptabilite.aideApports: Account credited when the till is topped up.
comptabilite.aideJournaux: Short journal code in your accounting software (e.g. CA till, BQ bank).

notation.sousTitre: Sets the weight of each indicator in the monthly score out of 100 — the 3 values must total 100. See the Usage scores page for the calculation and per-rep detail.

tourneesValidation.titre: Approval of routes scheduled by a sales rep
tourneesValidation.active: On: a route a sales rep schedules for themselves must be approved by a supervisor before visits.
tourneesValidation.desactive: Off: a sales rep can schedule and carry out their own route directly.

consommationIA.sousTitre: Number of times your team used AI features since the 1st of the month.

reconciliation.aide: Each sales rep gets a sub-account (root + number, e.g. 471001). Reconciliation entries use the accounts below.
reconciliation.aideRetenues: The debt reclassification (421 / 471) is always posted by DistribPro. Monthly deductions (422 / 421) must be booked by ONE software only: choose which to avoid duplicates.
reconciliation.parPaie: the payroll software (DistribPro only tracks them)
reconciliation.parDistribpro: DistribPro (do not book them in payroll)
reconciliation.aide_racine: Root of the sub-accounts created for each sales rep (471 → 471001…).
reconciliation.aide_avances: Root of the salary advance sub-accounts (421 → 421001…).
reconciliation.aide_ventes: Credited with cash sales collected by a rep.
reconciliation.aide_clients: Credited with collections by a rep.
reconciliation.aide_pertes: Debited with a written-off gap or debt.
reconciliation.aide_caisse: Debited with deposits if the till has no own account.
reconciliation.aide_remuneration: Debited with salary deductions, if DistribPro books them.
reconciliation.aideQuotite: E.g. 33%. Monthly cap = ratio × the rep's reference salary (lowest with the amount cap). Have your HR / adviser confirm the rate.

selecteurCompte.aideSousCompte: The number must start with {{parent}} and be longer.
selecteurCompte.sousCompteInvalide: A sub-account of {{parent}} must start with {{parent}} and be longer.
selecteurCompte.horsPlan: not in the chart of accounts

comptesClients.aide: Each customer gets a 411 sub-account; each customer group has a main account, parent of its members' accounts.
comptesClients.exemple: Example: single customer {{c}}0001 · group {{g}}001 · group member {{g}}001001.

fne.aide: Certifies your sales with the DGI (official reference + QR code). Requires registering on the DGI FNE platform and an API key issued after validation. Start in test mode.
fne.cleEnregistree: •••••• key saved — leave empty to keep it
fne.clePlaceholder: Paste the key from your FNE space
fne.pointDeVente: Point of sale (required by the DGI)
fne.parDefaut: 'Issue an FNE' ticked by default on each sale
fne.envoiAuto: Automatically email the receipt or invoice after each sale
fne.aideEnvoiAuto: Only if the customer has an email address. Sent from noreply@distribpro.com, replies go to your address.
fne.horsCi: FNE is the electronic invoice of Côte d'Ivoire's tax authority (DGI). It is not available for the country selected in “Country and tax”: your country's e-invoicing is not yet integrated into DistribPro. Your invoices are still issued normally.

rapportMensuel.aide: On the 1st of each month at 7 am, last month's activity report (PowerPoint with charts and analysis) is emailed.
rapportMensuel.aideDestinataires: Comma-separated. Leave empty to send to all admins and managers.

logo.aide: Shown at the top of all your documents: invoices and FNE, receipts, delivery notes, proformas, credit notes, cash vouchers, PowerPoint reports and customer emails. Transparent PNG recommended.
logo.enregistre: Logo saved: it now appears on your documents.
logo.confirmerRetrait: Remove the logo from all your documents?
logo.formatInvalide: Image not recognised: choose a PNG, JPEG or WebP file.

avoirs.aide: When a customer returns damaged or expired goods with a credit note, what should happen to them?
avoirs.aidePerte: They don't go back into stock; the loss stays traced on the credit note.
avoirs.stock: Put them back in stock as a "damaged" batch
avoirs.aideStock: They go back to a warehouse in a batch flagged as damaged (sold last, to be checked).

fiscalite.aide: Company country and VAT rules applied on invoices.
fiscalite.codeExoneration: FNE VAT code for sales without VAT
fiscalite.aideCodes: Used when the company is not VAT-registered or an item is at 0%. Items at 18% are sent as TVA (A), at 9% as TVAB (B). A customer (export, exempt) or an item can have its own code in its record.
fiscalite.horsCi: FNE (Côte d'Ivoire DGI) is disabled for this country. Your country's e-invoicing will be added once integrated.
fiscalite.codeFicheDefaut: Automatic (based on rate and company setting)

timbre.aide: Added to the part paid in cash, according to the scale in force in your country. It appears on the receipt and in the sales statement, separate from revenue (collected on behalf of the State).
timbre.activer: Apply the tax stamp to cash payments
timbre.aideBareme: Example: from 5,001 to 100,000 → stamp 100. Leave “To” empty for the last bracket. Check the scale with your accountant or current regulations.
